query:
SELECT format, file_path
        FROM book_files
        WHERE book_id = $1
          AND id <> $2
          AND available
          AND format <> 'KEPUB'
          AND source_type NOT IN ('on_demand_conversion', 'format_conversion')
        ORDER BY CASE format
                     WHEN 'EPUB' THEN 0
                     WHEN 'AZW3' THEN 1
                     WHEN 'AZW'  THEN 2
                     WHEN 'MOBI' THEN 3
                     ELSE 4
                 END
        LIMIT 1
